infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AstroParihar requires camera access for live 1-on-1 video consultations with verified Vedic astrologers.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AstroParihar requires microphone access for live voice consultations and interactive astrological voice queries.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AstroParihar uses your location to compute accurate Vedic planetary ascendants (Lagna), Janam Kundli charts, and local sunrise timings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AstroParihar requires photo library access to allow uploading birth charts and setting your devotee profile picture.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: AstroParihar uses speech recognition to convert your spoken astrological queries into text in real time.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow AstroParihar to use your location for accurate Vedic planetary calculations and astrologer discovery.
